narrative.overview: A light neutral workspace puts automatic estimates and their recorded evidence first. Optional manual validation follows the automatic results. Dense controls, restrained forest green actions, and flat divided sections support sustained desktop review. This records the built interface; no reference composition was supplied.
keyCharacteristics: Automatic estimates lead a persistent processing queue and video evidence.
Compact system typography and tabular measurements.
Explicit processing, estimated, unassigned, reviewed, and official-data labels.
dos: Do keep automatic estimates, raw crossings, reviewed observations, and official alliance data distinct.
Do preserve native video controls, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do organize dense information with borders and tonal surfaces.
donts: Don't present detections or estimated robot contributions as validated makes or official individual scores.
Don't substitute zero for missing or unreviewed data.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients, or hero metrics to this review surface.

automaticDashboard.primaryFlow: Read automatic estimates and evidence; manual validation is optional, with no processing start button

automaticDashboard.updates: five-second selected-match polling and fifteen-second queue polling; independent background worker; stale selection responses ignored
